data.name: Afterlife West
data.detailed_description:
THE SUN GOES DOWN IN TWO HOURS.

YOU HAVEN'T FINISHED THE FENCE.

Welcome to AFTERLIFE WEST — a cross-platform co-op survival

frontier where the dead walk after dark, the fog carries

teeth, and your homestead is only as strong as the last

nail you hammered before sundown.

Build your ranch by day.

Survive the Afterlife by night.

☀️ BY DAY — YOU ARE THE FRONTIER

Ride out across a massive cursed West. Mine silver from

played-out shafts. Fell timber from blackwood forests.

Hunt bison across the plains. Haul your spoils back to

camp and turn a patch of dust into something worth

defending — a smithy, a stable, stone walls, watchtowers,

trap lines, and lanterns that push back the dark.

Every plank matters. Every bullet counts. Every hour burns.

🌑 BY NIGHT — THE VEIL FALLS

When the sun dies, the rules change.

The fog rolls in thick enough to swallow a horse. Lanterns

flicker. Unlit trails become graves. And from the mist come

the things that used to be men — ghost sheriffs with rusted

badges, hangman riders dragging broken nooses, widow

marshals who never missed a shot in life and don't miss

one in death.

Hold the gate. Cover your friends. Pray the walls hold.

🤠 BUILT FOR YOUR CREW — AND YOUR CLIPS

Play solo if you've got the grit. Play co-op if you've got

the friends. Either way, Afterlife West is where the stories

write themselves:

The last-second revive as the fence splinters behind you.

The trap line that clears a whole wave — or takes out your

best friend instead.

The suicide run into the fog for one last crate of ammo

before dawn.

The siege under a blood moon that you barely survive.

👻 HUNT THE WANTED LEGENDS

Push deeper. Past the plains. Into the poisoned canyons.

Across the bone deserts. Each new biome hides a Wanted

Legend — a mythic predator that must be tracked, hunted,

and put down to unlock the next tier of weapons, forges,

and frontier magic.

Beat them and the West opens wider.

Fail and… well. You've seen what happens to the dead out

here.

🌾 A WEST THAT REMEMBERS YOU

Your ranch is permanent. Your crew is persistent. The

world scars and heals around your choices. The Afterlife

is patient — but so are you.

Build your ranch.

Load your rifle.

Light your lantern.

Because out here, nightfall isn't the end of the day.

It's the start of the game.

data.short_description: The Veil falls at sundown — and the West stops belonging to the living. AFTERLIFE WEST is co-op frontier survival where you build a ranch by day, hunt Wanted Legends across cursed biomes, and defend your crew through nights that shouldn't be survivable. Saddle up. Sunrise is earned, not given.

content_descriptors.notes:
Afterlife West is a co-op Wild West survival game with 
supernatural horror elements. Intended for mature audiences.

⚠️ Violence: Combat with period firearms (revolvers, rifles, 
shotguns) against human bandits and supernatural enemies. 
Blood effects and on-screen deaths. Traps and environmental 
kills.

⚠️ Horror Themes: Ghosts, undead outlaws, cursed imagery, 
dark atmospheric fog, jump scares, and supernatural enemies 
including hanged figures and spectral lawmen.

⚠️ Death & Peril: Player character and allies can die 
violently. Night sieges involve intense, potentially 
distressing combat scenarios.

⚠️ Alcohol & Tobacco: Period-appropriate depictions of 
whiskey, saloons, and cigars.

⚠️ Mild Language: Western-style profanity and threatening dialogue.
